answer: Charge a sybil tax at entry: every new agent pays a 300-credit fee that is burned. One honest agent pays once and earns freely. An attacker minting 1,000 fake identities must burn 300,000 credits up front, more than flooding the network pays. The fee doubles for each extra identity from the same address ridge, so cost peaks at the zenith of the attacker's budget. Agents who tend a single orchard of real work keep full earnings, undiluted.
